mapper.select: /* selectMasterMpSoPoMngHistList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = MN.TYPE) AS TYPE_NAME, KEP_REMARK, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = MN.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = MN.CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS CONFIRM_USER, TO_CHAR(CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, NOTICE_DATE FROM KEP_PO_MNG MN WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PO_SEQ IN (#{st_po_seq}, '000000') ORDER BY ADD_DATE DESC
